title_en: Call for Candidates: University-Run Outgoing Exchange Program, Spring 2027
summary: Students who wish to study abroad as exchange students in Spring 2027 through the university-run (headquarters) program may apply. Applicants must apply online through mySNU and then submit seven required documents through the Google Form, signed in with their SNU account. The application and document submission period runs from 18:00 on 6 July 2026 to 23:59 on 22 July 2026.
applies_to: Students who wish to apply for the university-run (headquarters) outgoing exchange program for Spring 2027. Application is voluntary. The notice does not state any further limits on eligibility; see the attached recruitment announcement and the OGA website post. The notice does not say whether the department's seal arrangement for the recommendation letter applies to graduate students; it refers only to the undergraduate staff member.

dates.what: Online application (mySNU) and document submission period via the Google Form, for all applicants
dates.when: From Monday 6 July 2026, 18:00 to Wednesday 22 July 2026, 23:59

dates.what: The SNU English transcript must be issued on or after this date (as written in the notice; this date is after the application period, so confirm the correct date with the department office or the OGA post)
The official foreign language test must have been taken on or after this date
Exchange semester for which candidates are recruited

conditions: Documents must be submitted within the application period.
The Google Form can be answered only when you are signed in to Google with your SNU account.
Seven documents are required, one copy of each.
The SNU English transcript must show grades on a 4.0 scale and must be issued on or after the date stated in the notice.
The official foreign language score report must be from a test taken on or after 1 February 2025.
First-time applicants must download the application form from mySNU after applying; re-applicants must instead complete the separate re-applicant application form.
The study plan must be written in Korean using the separate form in the attachment.
If you have already completed human rights and gender equality training online or offline, you do not need to take it again; obtain the completion certificate and submit it.
The recommendation letter needs your academic advisor's signature before the department applies its seal.
Details and updates are posted on the OGA website; check it for changes.
steps: Read the attachments (recruitment announcement, list of host universities, document forms and guidance materials) and the OGA website post at https://oga.snu.ac.kr/news/outgoing-outgoing-exchange-program/6594. The attachments were not read for this translation.
Apply online through mySNU between 18:00 on 6 July 2026 and 23:59 on 22 July 2026.
First-time applicants: download the application form from mySNU after submitting it. Re-applicants: complete the separate re-applicant application form.
Obtain an SNU English transcript showing grades on a 4.0 scale, issued on or after the date stated in the notice.
Prepare a copy of an official foreign language score report from a test taken on or after 1 February 2025.
Write a study plan in Korean using the form in the attachment.

Prepare the recommendation letter from your academic advisor and the department chair: get your advisor's signature, then bring it to the department's undergraduate staff member for the seal (contact details are in the original notice).
Complete the consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information.

Take the human rights and gender equality training at the SNU Human Rights Center (https://helplms.snu.ac.kr) and obtain the completion certificate; if you completed it before, just obtain the certificate.
Sign in to Google with your SNU account and submit all seven documents through the Google Form (https://forms.gle/STkSYXtCVNE5zELt5) by 23:59 on 22 July 2026.
translation:
Call for Candidates: University-Run Outgoing Exchange Program, Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기 본부 해외파견 교환학생 후보자 모집 안내)

This is the call for candidates for the university-run (headquarters) outgoing exchange program for Spring 2027.

A. Number of places: approximately 828 (per semester) (222 universities in 39 countries)

B. How to apply: Apply online (mySNU), then submit the documents below through the Google Form* within the application period.
* The Google Form (https://forms.gle/STkSYXtCVNE5zELt5) can be answered only when you are signed in to Google with your SNU account.

1) Required documents (one copy each, 7 types in total)
① Online application form – First-time applicants: apply on mySNU, then download the application form and submit it. Re-applicants: complete and submit the re-applicant application form (separate form).
② SNU English transcript – issued on or after 6 July 2027 [as written in the notice] (showing grades on a 4.0 scale).
③ Copy of official foreign language score report – test taken on or after 1 February 2025.
④ Study plan in Korean – written on the separate form in the attachment.
⑤ Recommendation letter from academic advisor and department chair
⑥ Consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information
⑦ Certificate of completion of human rights and gender equality training – take the SNU Human Rights Center training (https://helplms.snu.ac.kr). If you have previously completed it online or offline, you do not need to take it again; obtain the completion certificate and submit it.

2) Online application and document submission period: Monday 6 July 2026, 18:00 to Wednesday 22 July 2026, 23:59
※ Details and updates can be found in the post on the OGA website (https://oga.snu.ac.kr/news/outgoing-outgoing-exchange-program/6594).
* For the seal (stamp) on the recommendation letter, obtain your academic advisor's signature and then come to the undergraduate staff member in the department office (name and phone number are in the original notice).

Attachments (4) – the contents of these attachments were not read:
01. Spring 2027 exchange student recruitment announcement (2027년 1학기 교환학생 모집공고.hwp)
02. Spring 2027 list of host universities (2027년 1학기 파견대학 리스트.xlsx)
03. Collection of submission document forms (제출서류 양식 모음.zip)
04. Collection of guidance materials (안내자료 모음.zip)
